text: الٓر ۚ تِلْكَ ءَايَـٰتُ ٱلْكِتَـٰبِ وَقُرْءَانٍ مُّبِينٍ
translation: Alif, Lām, Rā.1 These are the verses of the Book and a clear Qur’ān [i.e., recitation].

text: رُّبَمَا يَوَدُّ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ لَوْ كَانُوا۟ مُسْلِمِينَ
translation: Perhaps those who disbelieve will wish1 that they had been Muslims.

text: ذَرْهُمْ يَأْكُلُوا۟ وَيَتَمَتَّعُوا۟ وَيُلْهِهِمُ ٱلْأَمَلُ ۖ فَسَوْفَ يَعْلَمُونَ
translation: Let them eat and enjoy themselves and be diverted by [false] hope, for they are going to know.

text: وَمَآ أَهْلَكْنَا مِن قَرْيَةٍ إِلَّا وَلَهَا كِتَابٌ مَّعْلُومٌ
translation: And We did not destroy any city but that for it was a known decree.

text: مَّا تَسْبِقُ مِنْ أُمَّةٍ أَجَلَهَا وَمَا يَسْتَـْٔخِرُونَ
translation: No nation will precede its term, nor will they remain thereafter.

text: وَقَالُوا۟ يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِى نُزِّلَ عَلَيْهِ ٱلذِّكْرُ إِنَّكَ لَمَجْنُونٌ
translation: And they say, "O you upon whom the message has been sent down, indeed you are mad.1

text: لَّوْ مَا تَأْتِينَا بِٱلْمَلَـٰٓئِكَةِ إِن كُنتَ مِنَ ٱلصَّـٰدِقِينَ
translation: Why do you not bring us the angels, if you should be among the truthful?"

text: مَا نُنَزِّلُ ٱلْمَلَـٰٓئِكَةَ إِلَّا بِٱلْحَقِّ وَمَا كَانُوٓا۟ إِذًا مُّنظَرِينَ
translation: We do not send down the angels except with truth;1 and they [i.e., the disbelievers] would not then be reprieved.

text: إِنَّا نَحْنُ نَزَّلْنَا ٱلذِّكْرَ وَإِنَّا لَهُۥ لَحَـٰفِظُونَ
translation: Indeed, it is We who sent down the message [i.e., the Qur’ān], and indeed, We will be its guardian.

text: وَلَقَدْ أَرْسَلْنَا مِن قَبْلِكَ فِى شِيَعِ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ
translation: And We had certainly sent [messengers] before you, [O Muḥammad], among the sects of the former peoples.

text: وَمَا يَأْتِيهِم مِّن رَّسُولٍ إِلَّا كَانُوا۟ بِهِۦ يَسْتَهْزِءُونَ
translation: And no messenger would come to them except that they ridiculed him.

text: كَذَٰلِكَ نَسْلُكُهُۥ فِى قُلُوبِ ٱلْمُجْرِمِينَ
translation: Thus do We insert it [i.e., denial] into the hearts of the criminals.

text: لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ بِهِۦ ۖ وَقَدْ خَلَتْ سُنَّةُ ٱلْأَوَّلِينَ
translation: They will not believe in it, while there has already occurred the precedent of the former peoples.

text: وَلَوْ فَتَحْنَا عَلَيْهِم بَابًا مِّنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ فَظَلُّوا۟ فِيهِ يَعْرُجُونَ
translation: And [even] if We opened to them a gate from the heaven and they continued therein to ascend,

text: لَقَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّمَا سُكِّرَتْ أَبْصَـٰرُنَا بَلْ نَحْنُ قَوْمٌ مَّسْحُورُونَ
translation: They would say, "Our eyes have only been dazzled. Rather, we are a people affected by magic."

text: وَلَقَدْ جَعَلْنَا فِى ٱلسَّمَآءِ بُرُوجًا وَزَيَّنَّـٰهَا لِلنَّـٰظِرِينَ
translation: And We have placed within the heaven great stars and have beautified it for the observers.

text: وَحَفِظْنَـٰهَا مِن كُلِّ شَيْطَـٰنٍ رَّجِيمٍ
translation: And We have protected it from every devil expelled [from the mercy of Allāh]

text: إِلَّا مَنِ ٱسْتَرَقَ ٱلسَّمْعَ فَأَتْبَعَهُۥ شِهَابٌ مُّبِينٌ
translation: Except one who steals a hearing and is pursued by a clear burning flame.

text: وَٱلْأَرْضَ مَدَدْنَـٰهَا وَأَلْقَيْنَا فِيهَا رَوَٰسِىَ وَأَنۢبَتْنَا فِيهَا مِن كُلِّ شَىْءٍ مَّوْزُونٍ
translation: And the earth - We have spread it and cast therein firmly set mountains and caused to grow therein [something] of every well-balanced thing.

text: وَجَعَلْنَا لَكُمْ فِيهَا مَعَـٰيِشَ وَمَن لَّسْتُمْ لَهُۥ بِرَٰزِقِينَ
translation: And We have made for you therein means of living and [for] those for whom you are not providers.1

text: وَإِن مِّن شَىْءٍ إِلَّا عِندَنَا خَزَآئِنُهُۥ وَمَا نُنَزِّلُهُۥٓ إِلَّا بِقَدَرٍ مَّعْلُومٍ
translation: And there is not a thing but that with Us are its depositories, and We do not send it down except according to a known [i.e., specified] measure.

text: وَأَرْسَلْنَا ٱلرِّيَـٰحَ لَوَٰقِحَ فَأَنزَلْنَا مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ مَآءً فَأَسْقَيْنَـٰكُمُوهُ وَمَآ أَنتُمْ لَهُۥ بِخَـٰزِنِينَ
translation: And We have sent the fertilizing winds1 and sent down water from the sky and given you drink from it. And you are not its retainers.

text: وَإِنَّا لَنَحْنُ نُحْىِۦ وَنُمِيتُ وَنَحْنُ ٱلْوَٰرِثُونَ
translation: And indeed, it is We who give life and cause death, and We are the Inheritor.1

text: وَلَقَدْ عَلِمْنَا ٱلْمُسْتَقْدِمِينَ مِنكُمْ وَلَقَدْ عَلِمْنَا ٱلْمُسْتَـْٔخِرِينَ
translation: And We have already known the preceding [generations] among you, and We have already known the later [ones to come].

text: وَإِنَّ رَبَّكَ هُوَ يَحْشُرُهُمْ ۚ إِنَّهُۥ حَكِيمٌ عَلِيمٌ
translation: And indeed, your Lord will gather them; indeed, He is Wise and Knowing.

text: وَلَقَدْ خَلَقْنَا ٱلْإِنسَـٰنَ مِن صَلْصَـٰلٍ مِّنْ حَمَإٍ مَّسْنُونٍ
translation: And We did certainly create man out of clay from an altered black mud.

text: وَٱلْجَآنَّ خَلَقْنَـٰهُ مِن قَبْلُ مِن نَّارِ ٱلسَّمُومِ
translation: And the jinn We created before from scorching fire.

text: وَإِذْ قَالَ رَبُّكَ لِلْمَلَـٰٓئِكَةِ إِنِّى خَـٰلِقٌۢ بَشَرًا مِّن صَلْصَـٰلٍ مِّنْ حَمَإٍ مَّسْنُونٍ
translation: And [mention, O Muḥammad], when your Lord said to the angels, "I will create a human being out of clay from an altered black mud.

text: فَإِذَا سَوَّيْتُهُۥ وَنَفَخْتُ فِيهِ مِن رُّوحِى فَقَعُوا۟ لَهُۥ سَـٰجِدِينَ
translation: And when I have proportioned him and breathed into him of My [created] soul,1 then fall down to him in prostration."

text: فَسَجَدَ ٱلْمَلَـٰٓئِكَةُ كُلُّهُمْ أَجْمَعُونَ
translation: So the angels prostrated - all of them entirely,

text: إِلَّآ إِبْلِيسَ أَبَىٰٓ أَن يَكُونَ مَعَ ٱلسَّـٰجِدِينَ
translation: Except Iblees;1 he refused to be with those who prostrated.

text: قَالَ يَـٰٓإِبْلِيسُ مَا لَكَ أَلَّا تَكُونَ مَعَ ٱلسَّـٰجِدِينَ
translation: [Allāh] said, "O Iblees, what is [the matter] with you that you are not with those who prostrate?"

text: قَالَ لَمْ أَكُن لِّأَسْجُدَ لِبَشَرٍ خَلَقْتَهُۥ مِن صَلْصَـٰلٍ مِّنْ حَمَإٍ مَّسْنُونٍ
translation: He said, "Never would I prostrate to a human whom You created out of clay from an altered black mud."

text: قَالَ فَٱخْرُجْ مِنْهَا فَإِنَّكَ رَجِيمٌ
translation: [Allāh] said, "Then depart from it,1 for indeed, you are expelled.

text: وَإِنَّ عَلَيْكَ ٱللَّعْنَةَ إِلَىٰ يَوْمِ ٱلدِّينِ
translation: And indeed, upon you is the curse until the Day of Recompense."

text: قَالَ رَبِّ فَأَنظِرْنِىٓ إِلَىٰ يَوْمِ يُبْعَثُونَ
translation: He said, "My Lord, then reprieve me until the Day they are resurrected."

text: قَالَ فَإِنَّكَ مِنَ ٱلْمُنظَرِينَ
translation: [Allāh] said, "So indeed, you are of those reprieved

text: إِلَىٰ يَوْمِ ٱلْوَقْتِ ٱلْمَعْلُومِ
translation: Until the Day of the time well-known."

text: قَالَ رَبِّ بِمَآ أَغْوَيْتَنِى لَأُزَيِّنَنَّ لَهُمْ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَلَأُغْوِيَنَّهُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ
translation: [Iblees] said, "My Lord, because You have put me in error, I will surely make [disobedience] attractive to them [i.e., mankind] on earth, and I will mislead them all

text: إِلَّا عِبَادَكَ مِنْهُمُ ٱلْمُخْلَصِينَ
translation: Except, among them, Your chosen servants."

text: قَالَ هَـٰذَا صِرَٰطٌ عَلَىَّ مُسْتَقِيمٌ
translation: [Allāh] said, "This is a path [of return] to Me [that is] straight.

text: إِنَّ عِبَادِى لَيْسَ لَكَ عَلَيْهِمْ سُلْطَـٰنٌ إِلَّا مَنِ ٱتَّبَعَكَ مِنَ ٱلْغَاوِينَ
translation: Indeed, My servants - no authority will you have over them, except those who follow you of the deviators.

text: وَإِنَّ جَهَنَّمَ لَمَوْعِدُهُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ
translation: And indeed, Hell is the promised place for them all.

text: لَهَا سَبْعَةُ أَبْوَٰبٍ لِّكُلِّ بَابٍ مِّنْهُمْ جُزْءٌ مَّقْسُومٌ
translation: It has seven gates; for every gate is of them [i.e., Satan's followers] a portion designated."

text: إِنَّ ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ فِى جَنَّـٰتٍ وَعُيُونٍ
translation: Indeed, the righteous will be within gardens and springs,

text: ٱدْخُلُوهَا بِسَلَـٰمٍ ءَامِنِينَ
translation: [Having been told], "Enter it in peace, safe [and secure]."

text: وَنَزَعْنَا مَا فِى صُدُورِهِم مِّنْ غِلٍّ إِخْوَٰنًا عَلَىٰ سُرُرٍ مُّتَقَـٰبِلِينَ
translation: And We will remove whatever is in their breasts of resentment,1 [so they will be] brothers, on thrones facing each other.

text: لَا يَمَسُّهُمْ فِيهَا نَصَبٌ وَمَا هُم مِّنْهَا بِمُخْرَجِينَ
translation: No fatigue will touch them therein, nor from it will they [ever] be removed.

text: ۞ نَبِّئْ عِبَادِىٓ أَنِّىٓ أَنَا ٱلْغَفُورُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ
translation: [O Muḥammad], inform My servants that it is I who am the Forgiving, the Merciful,

text: وَأَنَّ عَذَابِى هُوَ ٱلْعَذَابُ ٱلْأَلِيمُ
translation: And that it is My punishment which is the painful punishment.

text: وَنَبِّئْهُمْ عَن ضَيْفِ إِبْرَٰهِيمَ
translation: And inform them about the guests of Abraham,

text: إِذْ دَخَلُوا۟ عَلَيْهِ فَقَالُوا۟ سَلَـٰمًا قَالَ إِنَّا مِنكُمْ وَجِلُونَ
translation: When they entered upon him and said, "Peace." [Abraham] said, "Indeed, we are fearful [i.e., apprehensive] of you."

text: قَالُوا۟ لَا تَوْجَلْ إِنَّا نُبَشِّرُكَ بِغُلَـٰمٍ عَلِيمٍ
translation: [The angels] said, "Fear not. Indeed, we give you good tidings of a learned boy."

text: قَالَ أَبَشَّرْتُمُونِى عَلَىٰٓ أَن مَّسَّنِىَ ٱلْكِبَرُ فَبِمَ تُبَشِّرُونَ
translation: He said, "Have you given me good tidings although old age has come upon me? Then of what [wonder] do you inform?"

text: قَالُوا۟ بَشَّرْنَـٰكَ بِٱلْحَقِّ فَلَا تَكُن مِّنَ ٱلْقَـٰنِطِينَ
translation: They said, "We have given you good tidings in truth, so do not be of the despairing."

text: قَالَ وَمَن يَقْنَطُ مِن رَّحْمَةِ رَبِّهِۦٓ إِلَّا ٱلضَّآلُّونَ
translation: He said, "And who despairs of the mercy of his Lord except for those astray?"

text: قَالَ فَمَا خَطْبُكُمْ أَيُّهَا ٱلْمُرْسَلُونَ
translation: [Abraham] said, "Then what is your business [here], O messengers?"

text: قَالُوٓا۟ إِنَّآ أُرْسِلْنَآ إِلَىٰ قَوْمٍ مُّجْرِمِينَ
translation: They said, "Indeed, we have been sent to a people of criminals,

text: إِلَّآ ءَالَ لُوطٍ إِنَّا لَمُنَجُّوهُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ
translation: Except the family of Lot; indeed, we will save them all

text: إِلَّا ٱمْرَأَتَهُۥ قَدَّرْنَآ ۙ إِنَّهَا لَمِنَ ٱلْغَـٰبِرِينَ
translation: Except his wife." We [i.e., Allāh] decreed that she is of those who remain behind.1

text: فَلَمَّا جَآءَ ءَالَ لُوطٍ ٱلْمُرْسَلُونَ
translation: And when the messengers came to the family of Lot,

text: قَالَ إِنَّكُمْ قَوْمٌ مُّنكَرُونَ
translation: He said, "Indeed, you are people unknown."

text: قَالُوا۟ بَلْ جِئْنَـٰكَ بِمَا كَانُوا۟ فِيهِ يَمْتَرُونَ
translation: They said, "But we have come to you with that about which they were disputing,

text: وَأَتَيْنَـٰكَ بِٱلْحَقِّ وَإِنَّا لَصَـٰدِقُونَ
translation: And we have come to you with truth, and indeed, we are truthful.

text: فَأَسْرِ بِأَهْلِكَ بِقِطْعٍ مِّنَ ٱلَّيْلِ وَٱتَّبِعْ أَدْبَـٰرَهُمْ وَلَا يَلْتَفِتْ مِنكُمْ أَحَدٌ وَٱمْضُوا۟ حَيْثُ تُؤْمَرُونَ
translation: So set out with your family during a portion of the night and follow behind them and let not anyone among you look back and continue on to where you are commanded."

text: وَقَضَيْنَآ إِلَيْهِ ذَٰلِكَ ٱلْأَمْرَ أَنَّ دَابِرَ هَـٰٓؤُلَآءِ مَقْطُوعٌ مُّصْبِحِينَ
translation: And We conveyed to him [the decree] of that matter: that those [sinners] would be eliminated by early morning.

text: وَجَآءَ أَهْلُ ٱلْمَدِينَةِ يَسْتَبْشِرُونَ
translation: And the people of the city came rejoicing.1

text: قَالَ إِنَّ هَـٰٓؤُلَآءِ ضَيْفِى فَلَا تَفْضَحُونِ
translation: [Lot] said, "Indeed, these are my guests, so do not shame me.

text: وَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَلَا تُخْزُونِ
translation: And fear Allāh and do not disgrace me."

text: قَالُوٓا۟ أَوَلَمْ نَنْهَكَ عَنِ ٱلْعَـٰلَمِينَ
translation: They said, "Have we not forbidden you from [protecting] people?"

text: قَالَ هَـٰٓؤُلَآءِ بَنَاتِىٓ إِن كُنتُمْ فَـٰعِلِينَ
translation: [Lot] said, "These are my daughters1 - if you would be doers [of lawful marriage]."

text: لَعَمْرُكَ إِنَّهُمْ لَفِى سَكْرَتِهِمْ يَعْمَهُونَ
translation: By your life, [O Muḥammad], indeed they were, in their intoxication, wandering blindly.

text: فَأَخَذَتْهُمُ ٱلصَّيْحَةُ مُشْرِقِينَ
translation: So the shriek1 seized them at sunrise.

text: فَجَعَلْنَا عَـٰلِيَهَا سَافِلَهَا وَأَمْطَرْنَا عَلَيْهِمْ حِجَارَةً مِّن سِجِّيلٍ
translation: And We made the highest part [of the city] its lowest and rained upon them stones of hard clay.

text: إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَـَٔايَـٰتٍ لِّلْمُتَوَسِّمِينَ
translation: Indeed in that are signs for those who discern.

text: وَإِنَّهَا لَبِسَبِيلٍ مُّقِيمٍ
translation: And indeed, they [i.e., those cities] are [situated] on an established road.

text: إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَـَٔايَةً لِّلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
translation: Indeed in that is a sign for the believers.

text: وَإِن كَانَ أَصْحَـٰبُ ٱلْأَيْكَةِ لَظَـٰلِمِينَ
translation: And the companions of the thicket [i.e., the people of Madyan] were [also] wrongdoers,

text: فَٱنتَقَمْنَا مِنْهُمْ وَإِنَّهُمَا لَبِإِمَامٍ مُّبِينٍ
translation: So We took retribution from them, and indeed, both [cities] are on a clear highway.

text: وَلَقَدْ كَذَّبَ أَصْحَـٰبُ ٱلْحِجْرِ ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ
translation: And certainly did the companions of al-Ḥijr1 [i.e., the Thamūd] deny the messengers.

text: وَءَاتَيْنَـٰهُمْ ءَايَـٰتِنَا فَكَانُوا۟ عَنْهَا مُعْرِضِينَ
translation: And We gave them Our signs, but from them they were turning away.

text: وَكَانُوا۟ يَنْحِتُونَ مِنَ ٱلْجِبَالِ بُيُوتًا ءَامِنِينَ
translation: And they used to carve from the mountains, houses, feeling secure.

text: فَأَخَذَتْهُمُ ٱلصَّيْحَةُ مُصْبِحِينَ
translation: But the shriek seized them at early morning,

text: فَمَآ أَغْنَىٰ عَنْهُم مَّا كَانُوا۟ يَكْسِبُونَ
translation: So nothing availed them [from] what they used to earn.

text: وَمَا خَلَقْنَا ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَآ إِلَّا بِٱلْحَقِّ ۗ وَإِنَّ ٱلسَّاعَةَ لَـَٔاتِيَةٌ ۖ فَٱصْفَحِ ٱلصَّفْحَ ٱلْجَمِيلَ
translation: And We have not created the heavens and earth and that between them except in truth. And indeed, the Hour is coming; so forgive with gracious forgiveness.

text: إِنَّ رَبَّكَ هُوَ ٱلْخَلَّـٰقُ ٱلْعَلِيمُ
translation: Indeed, your Lord - He is the Knowing Creator.

text: وَلَقَدْ ءَاتَيْنَـٰكَ سَبْعًا مِّنَ ٱلْمَثَانِى وَٱلْقُرْءَانَ ٱلْعَظِيمَ
translation: And We have certainly given you, [O Muḥammad], seven of the often repeated [verses]1 and the great Qur’ān.

text: لَا تَمُدَّنَّ عَيْنَيْكَ إِلَىٰ مَا مَتَّعْنَا بِهِۦٓ أَزْوَٰجًا مِّنْهُمْ وَلَا تَحْزَنْ عَلَيْهِمْ وَٱخْفِضْ جَنَاحَكَ لِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
translation: Do not extend your eyes toward that by which We have given enjoyment to [certain] categories of them [i.e., the disbelievers], and do not grieve over them. And lower your wing [i.e., show kindness] to the believers.

text: وَقُلْ إِنِّىٓ أَنَا ٱلنَّذِيرُ ٱلْمُبِينُ
translation: And say, "Indeed, I am the clear warner" -

text: كَمَآ أَنزَلْنَا عَلَى ٱلْمُقْتَسِمِينَ
translation: Just as We had revealed [scriptures] to the separators1

text: ٱلَّذِينَ جَعَلُوا۟ ٱلْقُرْءَانَ عِضِينَ
translation: Who have made the Qur’ān into portions.1

text: فَوَرَبِّكَ لَنَسْـَٔلَنَّهُمْ أَجْمَعِينَ
translation: So by your Lord, We will surely question them all

text: عَمَّا كَانُوا۟ يَعْمَلُونَ
translation: About what they used to do.

text: فَٱصْدَعْ بِمَا تُؤْمَرُ وَأَعْرِضْ عَنِ ٱلْمُشْرِكِينَ
translation: Then declare what you are commanded1 and turn away from the polytheists.2

text: إِنَّا كَفَيْنَـٰكَ ٱلْمُسْتَهْزِءِينَ
translation: Indeed, We are sufficient for you against the mockers

text: ٱلَّذِينَ يَجْعَلُونَ مَعَ ٱللَّهِ إِلَـٰهًا ءَاخَرَ ۚ فَسَوْفَ يَعْلَمُونَ
translation: Who make [equal] with Allāh another deity. But they are going to know.

text: وَلَقَدْ نَعْلَمُ أَنَّكَ يَضِيقُ صَدْرُكَ بِمَا يَقُولُونَ
translation: And We already know that your breast is constrained by what they say.

text: فَسَبِّحْ بِحَمْدِ رَبِّكَ وَكُن مِّنَ ٱلسَّـٰجِدِينَ
translation: So exalt [Allāh] with praise of your Lord and be of those who prostrate [to Him].

text: وَٱعْبُدْ رَبَّكَ حَتَّىٰ يَأْتِيَكَ ٱلْيَقِينُ
translation: And worship your Lord until there comes to you the certainty [i.e., death].
